code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
# Corrected summary figure (previous panel-3 caption mislabelled the KIF3A position as Q530; it is Q588)
KLP11_CC=set([539,541,542,543,546,549,550,553,554,555,556,557,558,559,560,561,562,563,564,566,567,568,569,572,576,577,580,582,587,588,589,591,650,651,652,653,656,661,664,665,668,671,672,674,676,677,678,679,694,698,700,701,702,703,704,705,706,707,708,710])
KLP11_KAP=set([566,567,569,644,645,646,647,648,649,650,652,653,654,655,656,657,658,659,660,662,663,679,680,686,687,688,689,690,692,694,695,696,697,698,699,700,701,702,703,705,707,708,709,710,711,713,714,715,716,717,718,719,720,721])
KLP20_CC=set([533,536,539,540,541,543,544,545,546,547,548,549,550,551,552,553,554,556,557,558,566,570,572,577,578,579,581,586,600,601,602,603,604,605,606,607,608,609,610,611,612,613,618,619])
KLP20_KAP=set([557,558,559,560,562,565,566,569,582,584,585,586,607,611,612,613,614,615,616,619,621,622,623,624])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,8.5),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.1,1.0,1.0]})
ax=axes[0]
for y,(name,L,cc,kap,modelled,helix,strand) in enumerate([
    ("KLP-11 (Q19633)",782,KLP11_CC,KLP11_KAP,(537,722),[(544,567),(569,579),(657,673),(691,697)],[(580,582),(589,591)]),
    ("KLP-20 (Q965T6)",646,KLP20_CC,KLP20_KAP,(531,624),[(534,558),(559,568),(614,619)],[(571,572),(579,580)])]):
    yy=1-y
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,yy-0.12),L,0.24,fc="#E8E8EC",ec="#9A9AA6"))
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((10,yy-0.12),340,0.24,fc="#B9C6D9",ec="#5B6E8A"))
    ax.text(180,yy,"motor domain (approx.)",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((modelled[0],yy-0.19),modelled[1]-modelled[0],0.38,fc="none",ec="#C2512F",lw=1.6))
    ax.text(modelled[1]+8,yy+0.22,f"resolved in 9IKB {modelled[0]}-{modelled[1]}",fontsize=7.5,color="#C2512F")
    for a,b in helix: ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a,yy-0.12),b-a,0.24,fc="#F0C06A",ec="#B98A2A"))
    for a,b in strand: ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a,yy-0.12),max(b-a,2),0.24,fc="#7FB287",ec="#3F7A4A"))
    for p in sorted(cc): ax.plot([p],[yy-0.20],marker="|",color="#2F6FC2",ms=7,mew=1.2)
    for p in sorted(kap): ax.plot([p],[yy+0.20],marker="|",color="#B23A6E",ms=7,mew=1.2)
    ax.text(-25,yy,name,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-250,880); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,1.75); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("PDB 9IKB covers only the C-terminal tail of C. elegans kinesin-II; neck linker, neck coil and proximal stalk are absent\n"
             "blue ticks (below) = contacts with the partner motor subunit; pink ticks (above) = contacts with KAP-1",fontsize=9.5)
ax.plot([],[],color="#2F6FC2",marker="|",ls="",label="partner-subunit contact (<=5 A)")
ax.plot([],[],color="#B23A6E",marker="|",ls="",label="KAP-1 contact (<=5 A)")
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0,0),0,0,fc="#F0C06A",label="helix")); ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0,0),0,0,fc="#7FB287",label="beta strand"))
ax.legend(loc="lower center",ncol=4,fontsize=7.5,frameon=False)
ax=axes[1]
df=pd.DataFrame({"interface":["KLP-20 : KAP-1","KLP-11 : KLP-20","KLP-11 : KAP-1"],"BSA":[1288,2540,2486]})
ax.barh(df.interface,df.BSA,color=["#D9A3BC","#5B6E8A","#B23A6E"])
for i,v in enumerate(df.BSA): ax.text(v+30,i,f"{v:.0f}",va="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("buried surface area per interface (A$^2$, Shrake-Rupley, 1.4 A probe)",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("KLP-11 buries 1.9x more surface on KAP-1 than KLP-20 does (2542 vs 1328 A$^2$ per side)",fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_xlim(0,3100); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8.5)
ax=axes[2]; ax.axis("off")
ax.text(0.01,0.90,"Coiled-coil core (a/d) positions of the hetero-pairing trigger, assigned from 9IKB geometry (Crick deviation < 60 deg)",fontsize=9.5,transform=ax.transAxes)
ax.text(0.01,0.64,"KLP-11:  L546  I550  V553  L557  K560  V564  I568",fontsize=10.5,family="monospace",transform=ax.transAxes,color="#2F6FC2")
ax.text(0.01,0.44,"KLP-20:  V533  M536  I540  L543  L547  N550",fontsize=10.5,family="monospace",transform=ax.transAxes,color="#C2512F")
ax.text(0.01,0.10,"Asymmetric polar core layer: KLP-11 K560 packs against KLP-20 N550 (closest heavy-atom distance 3.98 A).\n"
                  "Same asymmetry in the vertebrate pair by alignment: KIF3B K583 opposite KIF3A Q588 (lysine on the B-type subunit, amide on the A-type subunit).",
        fontsize=9,transform=ax.transAxes)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
